Jack is a major character that appears in Dance with Me, the second story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. He is part of a group of thieves that steal from others to survive and share amongst each other.

page.overview:
Who is Jack?

Jack is a major character that appears in Dance with Me, the second story in Fazbear Frights 4: Step Closer. He is part of a group of thieves that steal from others to survive and share amongst each other.

Jack is a sharp-nosed and scrawny white guy with a lot of tattoos. Kasey compares him to a rat.

Jack is twitchy and fidgety, always seeming nervous when he's really just excited. He is also somewhat flamboyant. Jack and AJ have a habit of being reckless and blowing through the money they steal through partying. Jack likes to tease Kasey a lot, but it’s good-natured. He also doesn’t believe in superstition.

Jack, along with AJ, are part of a two-man group who commit petty theft. When they encounter Kasey, impressed by her skill in theft, they invite her to be a part of their group. Kasey agrees.
